name: sagemath-mcp-server
description: 10 symbolic-math tools for LLMs via SageMath's full computer algebra system.
long_description: Exposes SageMath's 100+ packages through 10 MCP tools so LLMs can delegate mechanical math (exact arithmetic, symbolic algebra, calculus, polynomial/integer factoring, matrix operations, plotting, LaTeX rendering, number theory) instead of computing inline. Wrapper is CC0-1.0; SageMath itself remains GPL-3.0 and runs as a separate subprocess. Requires either a local SageMath install or Docker on the host.

sage_docker_image.description: Image used when SageMath is not installed locally. Leave default unless you have a custom build.
